a1

b1
They carried off Sodom's goods, and Lot, Abram's nephew.
b2
A survivor told Abram the Hebrew.
c1
Abram armed 318 trained men and chased them to Dan.
c2
That night he divided his men and attacked.
c3
He brought back Lot, his goods, and all the people.
d0
Then the king of Sodom came out to meet him.
d1
And Melchizedek, king of Salem and priest of God Most High, brought out bread and wine.
d2
He blessed Abram in the name of God Most High, maker of heaven and earth.
d3
And Abram gave him a tenth of everything.
e1
The king of Sodom said: keep the goods, just give me the people.
e2
Abram refused: not a thread, not a sandal strap.
e3
So that no one could ever say: I made Abram rich.
h1
Lot had chosen for himself, yet Abram went to rescue him.
h2

h3

h4
